title: Quantile-Guided Diffusion for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.20739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantile forecasts summarize uncertainty at each future time step, while diffusion forecasters represent it through sampled future trajectories. We study how predicted quantiles can serve as distributional controls for diffusion forecasting. Specifically, we investigate how the mechanism of quantile integration affects its effectiveness in guiding a pretrained diffusion forecaster. We find that residual control throughout the denoising network yields the most consistent improvements. We instantiate this approach as Control-TS, which learns a quantile-control pathway while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Across eight benchmarks, Control-TS consistently improves the backbone's CRPS, achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art forecasting models, and retains its gains in capacity-matched comparisons. Further analyses examine how these gains depend on quantile granularity, predictor choice, and forecast quality. Finally

translated_title: 面向概率时间序列预测的分位数引导扩散模型
translated_abstract: 分位数预测在每个未来时间步上总结不确定性，而扩散预测器则通过采样的未来轨迹来表示不确定性。我们研究预测分位数如何可以作为分布控制手段来引导扩散预测。具体而言，我们探讨了分位数整合的机制如何影响其在引导预训练扩散预测器方面的有效性。我们发现，在整个去噪网络中引入残差控制能够带来最一致的改进。我们将该方法实例化为Control-TS，它在保持预训练主干网络冻结的同时学习一个分位数控制通路。在八个基准测试中，Control-TS持续提升了主干网络的CRPS，取得了与最先进预测模型相当的性能，并在容量匹配的比较中保持了其优势。进一步的分析考察了这些性能提升如何依赖于分位数粒度、预测器选择以及预测质量。
tldr: 提出Control-TS，在冻结的预训练扩散主干上学习分位数残差控制通路，将预测分位数作为分布控制来引导扩散预测，在八个基准上持续提升CRPS并达到与最先进模型相当的精度。
en_tdlr: Control-TS learns a quantile-control residual pathway on top of a frozen pretrained diffusion forecaster, using predicted quantiles as distributional controls, consistently improving CRPS across eight benchmarks while achieving performance competitive with state-of-the-art forecasting models.
